title: 行为树与 GOAP 混合架构
html:
行为树与 GOAP 混合架构

核心概念

纯 BT 的局限在于行为必须手工脚本化——设计师需要显式编写每一条「如果…则…」规则。当 NPC 需要在数十种可能行动中动态选择最优序列时，BT 的树结构会变得极为庞大。BT+GOAP 混合将两者的优势结合：BT 提供高层结构和可控性，GOAP 提供低层的动态规划灵活性。

graph TD
    Root[BT 根节点] --> S1[Selector]
    S1 --> Seq1[Sequence\n战斗模式]
    S1 --> Seq2[Sequence\n探索模式]
    Seq1 --> C1[Condition\nInCombat]
    Seq1 --> GOAP1[GOAPPlannerAction\n目标: KillEnemy]
    Seq2 --> C2[Condition\nAreaUnexplored]
    Seq2 --> GOAP2[GOAPPlannerAction\n目标: ExploreArea]
    GOAP1 --> A1[行动序列\n由 GOAP 动态生成]
    GOAP1 --> A2[FlankLeft / Suppress / Grenade\n运行时规划]
架构层 技术 职责 更新频率
高层决策 BT 模式切换（战斗/探索/逃跑） 每帧
中层规划 GOAP 动态生成行动序列 每次目标改变时
低层执行 BT 叶节点 单个行动的具体实现 每帧

GOAP 核心：世界状态与行动规划

GOAP 的规划基于世界状态谓词和行动的前提/效果：

interface WorldState {
  [predicate: string]: boolean;
}

interface GOAPAction {
  name: string;
  cost: number;
  preconditions: WorldState; // 执行此行动的前提
  effects: WorldState; // 行动执行后改变的状态
  isValid(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): boolean;
  execute(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): NodeStatus;
}

class GOAPPlanner {
  // A* 搜索：从 currentState 出发，找到到达 goalState 的最低成本行动序列
  plan(currentState: WorldState, goalState: WorldState, availableActions: GOAPAction[]): GOAPAction[] | null {
    const openList: PlannerNode[] = [
      {
        state: currentState,
        actions: [],
        cost: 0,
      },
    ];

    while (openList.length > 0) {
      // 取代价最低的节点
      openList.sort((a, b) => a.cost - b.cost);
      const current = openList.shift()!;

      // 检查是否达到目标
      if (this.satisfiesGoal(current.state, goalState)) {
        return current.actions;
      }

      // 扩展可执行行动
      for (const action of availableActions) {
        if (this.satisfiesPreconditions(current.state, action.preconditions)) {
          const newState = this.applyEffects(current.state, action.effects);
          openList.push({
            state: newState,
            actions: [...current.actions, action],
            cost: current.cost + action.cost,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return null; // 无法达成目标
  }

  private satisfiesGoal(state: WorldState, goal: WorldState): boolean {
    return Object.entries(goal).every(([k, v]) => state[k] === v);
  }

  private satisfiesPreconditions(state: WorldState, preconditions: WorldState): boolean {
    return Object.entries(preconditions).every(([k, v]) => state[k] === v);
  }

  private applyEffects(state: WorldState, effects: WorldState): WorldState {
    return { ...state, ...effects };
  }
}

BT 中集成 GOAP 规划节点

将 GOAP 规划器包装成 BT 的 Action 节点：

class GOAPPlannerNode implements BTNode {
  private currentPlan: GOAPAction[] = [];
  private planIndex = 0;
  private planner = new GOAPPlanner();

  constructor(
    private readonly goal: WorldState,
    private readonly actionPool: GOAPAction[],
    private readonly replanOnStateChange = true,
  ) {}

  tick(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): NodeStatus {
    const currentWorldState = this.extractWorldState(blackboard, agentId);

    // 首次或需要重规划时生成计划
    if (this.currentPlan.length === 0 || this.needsReplan(currentWorldState, blackboard, agentId)) {
      const validActions = this.actionPool.filter((a) => a.isValid(blackboard, agentId));
      const plan = this.planner.plan(currentWorldState, this.goal, validActions);

      if (!plan) {
        return NodeStatus.FAILURE; // 无法规划到目标
      }

      this.currentPlan = plan;
      this.planIndex = 0;
      blackboard.set(
        Keys.CURRENT_PLAN,
        plan.map((a) => a.name),
        agentId,
      );
    }

    // 执行当前计划中的行动
    if (this.planIndex >= this.currentPlan.length) {
      this.currentPlan = [];
      return NodeStatus.SUCCESS; // 计划执行完毕
    }

    const currentAction = this.currentPlan[this.planIndex];

    // 检查当前行动的前提是否仍然满足（世界可能发生变化）
    if (!this.satisfiesPreconditions(currentWorldState, currentAction.preconditions)) {
      this.currentPlan = []; // 重规划
      return NodeStatus.RUNNING;
    }

    const status = currentAction.execute(blackboard, agentId);
    if (status === NodeStatus.SUCCESS) {
      this.planIndex++;
    } else if (status === NodeStatus.FAILURE) {
      this.currentPlan = []; // 行动失败，重规划
    }

    return NodeStatus.RUNNING;
  }

  onAbort(): void {
    this.currentPlan = [];
    this.planIndex = 0;
  }

  private extractWorldState(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): WorldState {
    return {
      hasWeapon: blackboard.get<boolean>(Keys.HAS_WEAPON, agentId) ?? false,
      isInRange: blackboard.get<boolean>(Keys.IS_IN_RANGE, agentId) ?? false,
      enemyAlive: blackboard.get<boolean>(Keys.ENEMY_ALIVE, agentId) ?? false,
      inCover: blackboard.get<boolean>(Keys.IN_COVER, agentId) ?? false,
    };
  }

  private needsReplan(currentState: WorldState, bb: Blackboard, agentId: string): boolean {
    if (!this.replanOnStateChange) return false;
    const lastState = bb.get<WorldState>(Keys.LAST_PLAN_STATE, agentId);
    if (!lastState) return true;
    return JSON.stringify(currentState) !== JSON.stringify(lastState);
  }

  private satisfiesPreconditions(state: WorldState, preconditions: WorldState): boolean {
    return Object.entries(preconditions).every(([k, v]) => state[k] === v);
  }
}

Utility AI 打分 + BT 执行

另一种混合策略：用 Utility 评分选择最优子树，由 BT 负责执行：

class UtilitySelectorNode implements CompositeNode {
  tick(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): NodeStatus {
    // 对每个子节点评分，选最高分
    let bestScore = -Infinity;
    let bestIndex = -1;

    for (let i = 0; i < this.children.length; i++) {
      const scorer = this.scorers[i];
      const score = scorer.evaluate(blackboard, agentId);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        bestIndex = i;
      }
    }

    if (bestIndex === -1) return NodeStatus.FAILURE;

    // 如果选择切换了，中止当前运行的子节点
    if (this.currentIndex !== bestIndex) {
      this.children[this.currentIndex]?.onAbort?.();
      this.currentIndex = bestIndex;
    }

    return this.children[this.currentIndex].tick(blackboard, agentId);
  }
}

// 评分器：多因素加权评分
class CombatUtilityScorer {
  evaluate(blackboard: Blackboard, agentId: string): number {
    const enemyVisible = blackboard.get<boolean>(Keys.IS_ENEMY_VISIBLE, agentId) ? 1 : 0;
    const healthRatio = blackboard.get<number>(Keys.HEALTH_RATIO, agentId) ?? 1;
    const ammoRatio = blackboard.get<number>(Keys.AMMO_RATIO, agentId) ?? 1;
    const distance = blackboard.get<number>(Keys.ENEMY_DISTANCE, agentId) ?? 999;

    const distanceFactor = Math.max(0, 1 - distance / 20); // 越近分越高
    return enemyVisible * 0.4 + healthRatio * 0.3 + ammoRatio * 0.2 + distanceFactor * 0.1;
  }
}

小结

  • BT+GOAP 混合：BT 负责高层模式切换（可控、可预测），GOAP 负责低层动态行动规划（灵活）
  • GOAP 规划器的核心是 A* 搜索：将行动序列建模为图搜索问题
  • GOAPPlannerNode 需要处理三种情况：初次规划、世界变化后重规划、行动执行失败后重规划
  • Utility 评分 + BT 执行：在不改变 BT 树结构的情况下，让 Selector 具备连续评分能力
  • 规划频率控制很重要：避免每帧重规划（开销大），改为状态变化时触发或按固定频率
  • 混合架构的调试复杂度高于纯 BT，需要记录规划结果和重规划触发原因
